_quarry.citation: Polo, Marco. The Travels. Translated by Ronald Latham. London: Penguin Classics, 1958.
_quarry.notes: Old French Devisement du monde dictated by Marco Polo to fellow Genoese prisoner Rustichello of Pisa, c. 1298–99, recording Polo's 1271–95 travels through Persia, Central Asia, China, and the Indian Ocean. Latham's Penguin English translation is the standard general-reader edition; the Moule-Pelliot 1938 critical apparatus and Cliff's 2015 Penguin translation are the scholarly alternatives.
